root.label: Range adaptors and pipelines
root.note: Lazy views built from adaptor objects; the pipe only rearranges the call.

children.label: Adaptor objects
children.note: Every views:: name is a function object, specified in [range.adaptor.object].

children.label: Closure objects
children.note: Take one range; C(r) and r | C are equivalent, as with views::reverse or views::join.

children.label: Partial application
children.note: views::filter(p) stores p and returns a closure; r | views::filter(p) is views::filter(r, p).

children.label: Composing closures
children.note: C | D is a closure, and r | (C | D) means D(C(r)), the same as r | C | D.

children.label: Not pipeable
children.note: zip, cartesian_product and concat take many ranges; xs | views::zip(ys) does not compile.

children.label: Adaptors to know
children.note: C++20 gave selection and reshaping; C++23 added the range-v3 favourites.

children.label: C++20 core
children.note: filter, transform, take, drop, take_while, drop_while, join, split, reverse, keys, values.

children.label: C++23 additions
children.note: zip, enumerate, chunk, slide, stride, cartesian_product, as_rvalue, as_const.

children.label: split vs lazy_split
children.note: split needs a forward range and yields subranges; lazy_split takes input ranges, weak pieces.

children.label: Category kept or lost
children.note: An adaptor offers only what it can do in constant time on its input.

children.label: filter
children.note: At most bidirectional and never sized, since gaps between matches are unknown.

children.label: transform
children.note: Keeps random access and size but is never contiguous: values are computed.

children.label: take on a list
children.note: Sized but not common: counted_iterator paired with default_sentinel.

children.label: Cheaper return types
children.note: take and drop on span, string_view or sized iota_view return that same kind of type.

children.label: Evaluation surprises
children.note: Work happens at dereference time, every time.

children.label: transform then filter
children.note: The function runs once to test and again to read every element that passes.

children.label: Writing through filter
children.note: Undefined behavior if the new value fails the predicate, per [range.filter.iterator].

children.label: Regular functions
children.note: transform and filter require regular_invocable: same input, same output.

children.label: Caching
children.note: begin() must be amortized O(1), so some views remember their first position.

children.label: Who caches
children.note: filter, split, chunk_by, drop on non-random-access inputs, reverse on non-common inputs.

children.label: No const iteration
children.note: Caching begin() is non-const, so a const filter_view is not a range.

children.label: Stale cache
children.note: Changing underlying data after a pass does not move the cached begin; recreate the view.

children.label: Custom adaptors
children.note: C++23 range_adaptor_closure gives your own function object the pipe.

children.label: CRTP base
children.note: Derive D from range_adaptor_closure<D> exactly once; D must not itself be a range.

children.label: Arguments
children.note: Store them as members, or build the closure with std::bind_back over an adaptor.
